content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Long Range Strike - Bomber (program element 0604015F) is a U.S. Air Force development program funded in the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "921c5c29252021c5"}}, {"text": "The program funds the B-21 Raider, a dual-capable penetrating-strike stealth bomber designed to deliver both conventional and nuclear munitions and to operate in tomorrow's high-end threat environment.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d7e10b594385b0b8"}}, {"text": "The B-21 is described as crucial to the nuclear-modernization plan and the backbone of the nation's future bomber force, with an open system architecture intended to enable rapid integration of future capabilities as threats evolve; the Air Force requires a minimum of 100 B-21s as part of the long-term bomber force.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}, {"text": "The Engineering and Manufacturing Development (EMD) contract was awarded in 2015, a Critical Design Review was completed in 2018, and an approved Milestone C decision with all statutory and regulatory documentation was completed in 2023, after which the first two production lots were awarded.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}, {"text": "The effort sits in Budget Activity 4, Advanced Component Development and Prototypes, because the work evaluates integrated technologies, representative modes, or prototype systems in a high-fidelity, realistic operating environment.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}, {"text": "The program tracks a separate B-21 Modernization budget-program activity, created in 2024 to track modernization funding apart from the EMD funding line, alongside the core development effort.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ba4bb09c51a9300e"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding grows from $2,654,073 thousand in FY2025 to $4,739,145 thousand (about $4.74 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "c87e02d8d5d8f25d"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $2,085,072 thousand (roughly $2.09 billion) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "5045dab67b7d8823"}}, {"text": "A Fiscal Receipts feed event flagged Long Range Strike - Bomber as increasing 79% from FY2025 to FY2026, one of the larger year-over-year swings in the budget.", "citation": {"fact_id": "5045dab67b7d8823"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $2,877,844 thousand (about $2.88 billion), so the FY2026 request is well above its recent execution level.", "citation": {"fact_id": "921c5c29252021c5"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request splits nearly evenly between funding types: a discretionary request of $2,347,225 thousand (about $2.35 billion) and a reconciliation (mandatory) request of $2,391,920 thousand (about $2.39 billion).", "citation": {"fact_id": "19e2b895a2bcfedd"}}, {"text": "The program's budget narrative states that the FY2026 request includes 2,347.225 million of discretionary and 2,391.920 million of mandatory (reconciliation) for a total of 4,739.145 million, with the mandatory funds financing an expansion of B-21 capacity and further detail provided in Section 20008 (Nuclear) of the Reconciliation Exhibit.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}, {"text": "Within the request, the B-21 Development budget-program activity accounts for $1,589.908 million of discretionary and $2,391.920 million of mandatory/reconciliation funds — comprising a $1,721.920 million enhancement and a $670 million transfer from discretionary — for a total of $3,981.828 million.", "citation": {"fact_id": "6744539bc83ec97f"}}, {"text": "The separately tracked B-21 Modernization budget-program activity accounts for $757 million of discretionary funding and no mandatory (reconciliation) funding in FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ba4bb09c51a9300e"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "d05a7c6e8a54e7dd"}}, {"text": "The program is reported to Congress under Title 10, United States Code, Section 119(a)(1) in the Special Access Program Annual Report, reflecting its classified special-access status.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}, {"text": "Test aircraft are executing the B-21 flight-test campaign, and the program's mission narrative states that B-21 aircraft will be delivered to operational bases in the mid-2020s.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3a38373773bf202d"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
